name: Sawamura Yuuta
source:
Yuuta has been possess by the goddess as he accidentally broke her rest area. The goddess that possess him needed to use his luck in order to survive making him unlucky. The goddess also tells him that the 3 girls has the miko's blood.

Yuuta also lives with his grandparents and his grandfather doesn't really like him as he blames his father for his mother's death. Yuuta later gets along with his grandfather and his grandmother says he looks very much like his mother. The heroines say that if he crossdress he will look like his mother.
